hook: We make social graphics for clients all week. The tool we wanted didn't exist, so we built it.
direction: Launch post for Poaster (poaster.co), Bequest's own social-graphics tool. The 40-second demo video is the asset: paste a link, the brand loads, finished graphics come out. CTA: 3 free downloads at poaster.co, no account needed. Graphic: promo video (4:5) with the hook frame as thumbnail fallback.

facebook.text:
We make social graphics for clients all week. The tool we wanted didn't exist, so we built it.

Poaster works the way busy teams actually work. Paste your website link and it picks up your brand on its own, right down to the fonts. Pick a post type and it hands you polished graphics in every size you need. No design software, no template rabbit hole.

The video shows the whole workflow on a phone, start to finish, in about 40 seconds.

Try it at poaster.co. 3 free downloads before you even sign up, no account or card needed.
